title: OP SCRIPT KEYLESS | Besto
features:
​🕹️ Movement Options

​WalkSpeed & JumpPower Sliders: Adjust your movement speed and jump height in real time.

​Noclip (Wallhack Movement): Bypass wall collisions using RunService.Stepped physics manipulation to walk through solid obstacles.

​Infinite Jump: Jump repeatedly in mid-air without falling back down.

​Click TP (Ctrl + Left Click): Instantly teleport to any location targeted by your mouse cursor.

​Anti-Ragdoll / Anti-Stun: Prevents your character from going into a ragdoll state or getting knocked down by hazards/attacks.

​👁️ Visuals & ESP Engine

​Monster / Entity ESP: Highlights all NPCs, bots, and monsters in red across the map (including hidden or immortal entities).

​Player-to-Monster Detection: Automatically identifies players who have transformed into monsters/killers (e.g., in Piggy, Infection, or Flee the Facility) based on tags and team metadata.

​Player ESP: Highlights non-monster players in blue with their display names.

​Exit / Door ESP: Highlights escape doors, exits, and key pathways in green.

​Item / Loot ESP: Highlights collectible items, keys, and tools in orange.

​Fullbright / Anti-Fog: Clears map darkness and fog by adjusting ambient lighting for full visibility.

​Show Tracers: Draws 2D tracer lines from the bottom center of your screen directly to target entities.

​⚔️ Combat Adjustments

​Smart Aimlock: Automatically snaps your camera toward the nearest monster or entity within a specified distance.

​Aimlock Distance Range: Customizable slider to limit or extend the target tracking distance.

​Expand Head Hitbox: Enlarges the head size and collision zone of entities to make aiming and landing hits significantly easier.

​⚙️ Utility & Quality of Life

​God Mode: Continuously restores your character's health to maximum.

​Auto-Interact: Automatically triggers ProximityPrompt interactions (doors, levers, items) when in range.

​Anti-AFK: Sends virtual inputs to prevent Roblox from disconnecting you due to inactivity.

​Zoom Bypass: Unlocks maximum camera distance limits, allowing unlimited zoom out.

​🛡️ System & Architecture

​Weak Tables (__mode = "v" / "k"): Prevents memory leaks by allowing garbage collection to clean up deleted objects.

​Throttle Jitter Scanning: Scans workspace descendants in batches to prevent frame drops or game freezes on heavy maps.

​Character Protection System: Maintains speed and jump settings automatically when your character respawns.

​Modern Tab UI: Built-in floating toggle button, sleek animated intro screen, and sound effects for UI actions.
